description: Pause a schedule so it stops running, or resume it. A paused schedule keeps its settings and its past runs. Resuming works out its next run time from now.

active.description: False pauses it, true resumes it.
active.title: Active

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

schedule.description: The schedule's id, as list_schedules shows it.
schedule.title: Schedule

name: set_schedule_active
